# CAREER JOURNAL 1.0.3

Application materials are now useful directly from the local dashboard. Each archived resume or cover letter has an **Open file** action that opens the stored document in a separate browser tab.

The browser receives only an artifact ID. Local storage paths remain private, and the server refuses to read files outside the configured artifact directory.

This release fixes material cards that previously showed a filename and checksum without providing access to the file.

---

# CAREER JOURNAL 1.0.3 中文说明

现在可以直接从本地看板打开申请材料。每份已经归档的简历或求职信都有“打开文件”入口，点击后会在新的浏览器标签中显示。

网页只会拿到材料 ID，不会看到文件在电脑上的真实路径。服务端也会拒绝读取配置材料目录以外的文件。

这个版本修复了材料卡片只能显示文件名和哈希、却无法打开文件的问题。
